newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy to begin Albania troop withdrawal July 18.
newsitem.headline: Italy to begin Albania troop withdrawal July 18.

text.p: Italy will begin its withdrawal of troops in a multinational security force in Albania on July 18 and expects to complete it by August 10, a defence ministry undersecretary said on Friday.
"The withdrawal will begin on July 18 and should be completed within the first 10 days of August," undersecretary Massimo Brutti said at a military ceremony south of Rome.
Italy has led the 7,000-strong International Protection Force in Albania since its deployment in April to guard the distribution of humanitarian aid and monitor general elections.

Its mandate was originally set to run out on June 28, the day before Albanians went to the polls, but was extended to cover a limited period after the elections following a request from Albania's national unity government.
Prime Minister Romano Prodi said on Thursday Italy would help contribute to the smooth completion of the electoral process in Albania, which has a second round of voting on July 7.

The Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) warned Albania's political parties on Thursday against putting obstacles in the way of the electoral process after violence delayed the counting of first round ballots.
